title: Rory and the River of Dreams
verses:
As the sun settled down in a valley of blue,
And Rory walked slowly to rest by the stream.
The moss on the river was covered in dew,
And wrapped every tree in a silvery dream.

When Nia flew down through the cool evening air,
And Tilly brought blossoms that bloomed in the night,
They gathered together with soft beds to share,
To watch as the river reflected the light.

Now Benny walked in through the tall forest trees,
While Ricky bounced up on a moss-covered stone.
They sheltered from wind in the soft summer breeze,
So no one would sit in the darkness alone.

Then Psittaco nestled right down in the leaves,
And curled up by Rory to rest in the shade.
The wind softly hummed through the forest and eaves,
To listen to tunes that the night-crickets played.

The moon was a crescent of glittering gold,
That shone on the hill where the tall grasses sway,
The stories of bedtime were lovingly told,
To welcome the dreams at the end of the day.

Now Rory closed eyes as he let out a sigh,
While all of his friends settled down for the night.
A soft lullaby drifted down from the sky,
And held them in peace till the morning was bright.
